basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old software developer from Portland, Oregon. I have a keen interest in virtual reality and emerging tech, which often leads me down the rabbit hole of new software and gaming experiences. When I'm not coding or gaming, you'll find me strumming my guitar along to The Front Bottoms or browsing for new indie bands. I work remotely, which gives me the flexibility to be online mostly during late afternoons and evenings. Single and loving the freedom, I often join online communities to connect with like-minded individuals.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, my expertise lies in software development and virtual reality. I've been programming since my teenage years, starting with simple scripts and gradually moving to complex VR applications. My current role involves developing user interfaces for VR platforms, which keeps me updated with the latest trends in tech.
